title: fix(plugin-dashboard): a dimensioned pie / donut / funnel / treemap / sankey says which measures it drops (objectui#11417)
body:
Part of #11417. What stays open is triage's item 2: at the pin bump that carries objectstack-ai/objectstack#21293, objectui's `DashboardWidgetSchema` mirror follows the refusal. Measured below (item 2): that needs objectui code at the bump, so the card stays open after this PR merges.

Clause-②: no

## What changes

A dataset widget of the `pie` / `donut`, `funnel`, `treemap` or `sankey` family with a dimension and two or more measures hands every measure to the shared chart renderer as a series, and the renderer draws the first series only. The query ran both measures, every door accepted the document, and nothing said the second measure was dropped.

- `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx`: one new set, `SINGLE_SERIES_CHART_FAMILIES`, read off the family a widget renders AS (`CHART_TYPE_MAP`, so a stored `pyramid` is in it through `funnel`). `renderedMeasures` now says "the first measure only" for a chart of that family, and the existing dropped-measure diagnostic (objectui#8894, PR objectui#11416) names the dropped measures. ⛔ No change to what is drawn: the chart schema handed to the renderer is byte-unchanged (every measure is still a series).
- The message for this shape ends with the cause, `Its chart family "pie" draws a single series: the first declared measure.`, and points to no ADR-0087 entry. The tile's pointer (`dashboard-widget-metric-family-multi-measure-refused`) answers for "a one-number tile with several measures", which a chart with a dimension is not; no entry at spec 17.5.0 answers for this shape, and none is invented.
- `packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md`, `content/docs/plugins/plugin-dashboard.mdx` and the pending `.changeset/8894-dashboard-measures-not-rendered.md` said this shape "draws only the first, with no warning (objectui#11417)"; they now say the warning covers it. New `.changeset/11417-dashboard-single-series-dropped-measure.md` (`@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` patch).

## The PM's mechanism assumptions, measured

1. **One source for "what the chosen branch renders".** The renderer exposes no declaration of the single-series families: its arms are `chartType === …` branches, and the one set it declares, `SERIES_ONLY_CHART_TYPES` (families that draw `series.map(…)` and nothing else), is not this set's complement (`radar` draws every series, `scatter` refuses). plugin-dashboard also reaches plugin-charts only as a devDependency. So the list lives once, in `DatasetWidget`, and a pin ties it to the renderer by behaviour, not by name: `DatasetWidget.singleSeriesMeasures-11417.test.tsx`, block "the TIE", renders every chart type `@objectstack/spec`'s `ChartTypeSchema` declares (13 after the metric family and `table` / `pivot`) through the REAL chain (`DatasetWidget` → `SchemaRenderer` → registry `chart` → `AdvancedChartImpl`), changes the second measure's values, and requires the diagnostic to fire exactly when the drawn markup does not change. Controls per type: same rows twice give identical markup; changed FIRST-measure values give different markup (the plot painted).
2. **The arms.** The five drawing arms are the `pie` / `donut` arm (`const pieDataKey = series[0]?.dataKey || 'value'`), the `funnel` arm, the `treemap` arm and the `sankey` arm (`const rootName = series[0]?.label || dataKey`). Two of the brief's six `series[0]` reads are not drawing arms of the five: one is the pie CLICK handler (`handlePieClick`), the other the metric-family single-value arm (`SINGLE_VALUE_CHART_TYPES`). `scatter` was measured and is NOT added: with two series it renders a visible refusal naming them (`SeriesArityRefusal`, `data-chart-error="scatter-multi-series"`), so nothing is dropped in silence; the tie pin accepts exactly that refusal for `scatter` and stays silent there.
3. **The message.** The tile pointer sentence would have been false for this shape (it is about a one-number tile); see "What changes".
4. **README / docs / changeset.** Corrected in this PR, as above.
5. **Item 2, the mirror.** `DashboardWidgetSchema` in `packages/types/src/zod/complex.zod.ts` re-attaches the spec's object-level checks by NAMED import, one `.superRefine(checkX)` line per exported check (`checkDashboardWidgetStageOrder`, `checkDashboardWidgetMetricMeasureArity`), and `packages/types/src/__tests__/spec-object-refinements-7715.test.ts` reddens on any check the spec adds until a line and a census row are added. It does not follow new checks wholesale. objectstack `main` (`4e6dc233`) already exports a third, `checkDashboardWidgetDimensionlessMeasureArity` (objectstack#21053), which objectui does not chain yet; whether objectstack#21293 widens that export or adds a fourth, the bump carrying it needs at least one re-attachment line in objectui. Hence `Part of`.

## Tests (final head `6d55dd12c`)

- New `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DatasetWidget.singleSeriesMeasures-11417.test.tsx`, 22 tests: five SUBJECT pins (triage's: each of the five types with a dimension and two measures names `"cost"` as dropped and `"revenue"` as rendered; both doors accept the document), a SUBJECT on the message (cause stated, no ADR-0087 entry, no advice, no other type named), a SUBJECT for a stored `pyramid` (the family decides), CONTROL one measure on a dimensioned `pie` (silent, triage's), CONTROL a dimensioned `bar` with two measures (silent), and the 13-row tie.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DatasetWidget.singleSeriesMeasures-11417.test.tsx packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DatasetWidget.unrenderedMeasures-8894.test.tsx` at `6d55dd12c`: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 34 passed (34)`.
- Whole package, `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-dashboard/` at `a83d34002`: `Test Files 160 passed (160)`, `Tests 1527 passed | 6 skipped (1533)`. The only later commit (`6d55dd12c`) edits the new test file alone, re-run above.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard type-check` (script name echoed: `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`), exit 0, after `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-dashboard^...' run build` (13 packages), exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists the new test file.

## Ablations (implementation committed first; each through `ablation-replace.mjs` with an on-disk anchor count and a blob-hash restore to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty after each)

- Empty the set (an empty string set, spelled with the generic STRING parameter, which the sanitizer would eat if written literally): 12 red — the five triage SUBJECTs, the message and `pyramid` SUBJECTs, and the five tie rows for the single-series types; controls and the other 8 tie rows green; the objectui#8894 file 12/12 green.
- Over-include `radar` and `bar`: 4 red — both `bar` silence controls (this file and the objectui#8894 file) and the `bar` and `radar` tie rows. The tie catches a family wrongly added, not only one left out.
- Message falls back to the tile pointer for a chart: 2 red — the message SUBJECT and the `pyramid` SUBJECT.

## Acceptance notes

- Observation, not filed (read-only inference, carrier: none): with two dimensions and ONE measure, `buildChartSeries` pivots the second dimension into series, and these five arms draw the first group's column only. That drops groups, not declared measures, so the diagnostic (which compares measures) does not speak; not measured on a rendered chart.
- Observation, not filed (carrier: the pin-bump PR that carries objectstack#21053 / #21293): `MEASURE_AXIS_CHART_FAMILIES` in `DatasetWidget.tsx` restates the set objectstack `main` exports as `DASHBOARD_WIDGET_MULTI_MEASURE_TYPES`, whose docblock says objectui's mirror is to import it rather than restate it; it is not in spec 17.5.0.
- When the pin carries objectstack#21293, the two door assertions in this PR's SUBJECT pins go red on purpose; their messages say so, and the pin then becomes one about a stored document, as objectui#8894's stored-metric pin is.
